stages.description: A special egg given by Professor Nano to new researchers. Its simple design belies the wonder within.
stages.name: Tutoria Egg

stages.description: A friendly creature that emerges from the Tutoria Egg. It serves as a companion to help new researchers learn the basics of Nanobeast research.
stages.name: Tutoria

stages.description: Ampaw is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Ampaw Egg

stages.description: Ampaw are known for their incredible punching power, generated by the electric current flowing through their armored gauntlets. They train rigorously to hone their electrical and fighting skills, often seen sparring with rocks to test their strength.
stages.name: Ampaw

stages.description: Ampunch are known for their incredible punching power, generated by the electric current flowing through their armored gauntlets. They train rigorously, honing their skills against boulders and causing localized power outages.
stages.name: Ampunch

stages.description: Ampact stores immense electrical energy in its muscles and releases it through devastating punches. Its blue markings glow when fully charged, and its strikes leave the air crackling with static.
stages.name: Ampact

stages.description: Aquablossom is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Aquablossom Egg

stages.description: Aquablossom gracefully navigates ponds and streams, its lilypad crest now a blossoming flower. This creature exudes serenity, and its gentle presence often calms agitated waters and soothes troubled minds.
stages.name: Aquablossom

stages.description: Hydralilly purifies polluted rivers and restores plant life along their banks. Normally serene, it fiercely protects its waters, using powerful currents to drive away creatures that threaten the surrounding ecosystem.
stages.name: Hydralilly

stages.description: Aquamity is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Aquamity Egg

stages.description: Aquamity is a playful creature known for its calm demeanor and ability to purify water sources. Its gentle nature makes it a favorite among those seeking a peaceful companion; it often drifts along on currents, lost in thought.
stages.name: Aquamity

stages.description: Dragquanimity represents a phase of inner growth, mediating between water and sky. It is said to be able to control minor rain patterns, bringing balance to the local ecosystem. They are often found meditating by waterfalls.
stages.name: Dragquanimity

stages.description: Seraphydra brings balance to water and sky, calming rough seas and summoning gentle rain. Legends say its glowing presence guides those who have lost their way through violent storms.
stages.name: Seraphydra

stages.description: Circute is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Circute Egg

stages.description: Circute are playful automatons, often found mimicking human behaviors. Their red-ringed sensors detect threats, triggering surprising bursts of speed and defensive maneuvers despite their egg-like shape.
stages.name: Circute

stages.description: Synaptor are formidable guardians, their metallic exoskeletons providing unparalleled defense. Their red-rimmed sensors are constantly scanning for threats, allowing them to react with surprising speed and precision.
stages.name: Synaptor

stages.description: Cognetix are relentless juggernauts, their reinforced chassis and massive fists capable of pulverizing any obstacle. These ultimate Cognetix forms are programmed for total annihilation, leaving nothing but scrap metal in their wake.
stages.name: Cognetix

stages.description: Drakling is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Drakling Egg

stages.description: Drakling is a playful creature, often found gazing at the night sky. It's said that wishing upon a Drakling brings good fortune, though it might playfully nibble on your fingers first!
stages.name: Drakling

stages.description: Noctalisk gracefully glides through the night, its starry wings scattering shimmering dust. Legends say it guides lost travelers, using the constellations as its map, leading them to safety and fortune.
stages.name: Noctalisk

stages.description: Cosmeraus travels through the night sky, weaving starlight into shifting constellations. Its pale purple glow guides wandering creatures, and its arrival is said to mark a peaceful night beneath the stars.
stages.name: Cosmeraus

stages.description: Draklysm is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Draklysm Egg

stages.description: Draklysm slips through the walls of ancient ruins, leaving cold mist behind. Though fond of harmless tricks, it can topple a small tree with a single flick of its spectral tail.
stages.name: Draklysm

stages.description: Triklopsar guards its solitary lair with devastating blasts of spectral energy. Scorched ground marks the edges of its territory, warning rival creatures to keep their distance from the fiercely protective predator.
stages.name: Triklopsar

stages.description: Emberspout is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Emberspout Egg

stages.description: Emberspout are playful creatures known for their bubbly personalities and tendency to create small geysers. They are said to bring good luck to those who find them.
stages.name: Emberspout

stages.description: Geyserpent are known to meditate near hot springs, seemingly absorbing the energy within. They are said to be able to predict small changes in volcanic activity.
stages.name: Geyserpent

stages.description: Flarva is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Flarva Egg

stages.description: Flarva are playful and curious creatures, often found near volcanic hot springs. Their cheerful disposition and bright colors make them a favorite among novice adventurers, though their fiery burps can be startling.
stages.name: Flarva

stages.description: Igneatoad are known for their resilience and ability to thrive in harsh volcanic environments. They are territorial and fiercely protect their chosen basking spots, using their heated skin to deter predators.
stages.name: Igneatoad

stages.description: Lavacrook are powerful guardians of volcanic peaks, revered for their unwavering loyalty and devastating fiery breath. Legends say they can control lava flows with a single croak, shaping the landscape to their will.
stages.name: Lavacrook

stages.description: Glitchlet is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Glitchlet Egg

stages.description: Glitchlet is a mischievous creature that loves to play pranks with its psychic abilities. It often appears near electronic devices, causing minor glitches and disruptions.
stages.name: Glitchlet

stages.description: As Devicore evolves, it learns to control its psychic powers with more precision, manipulating digital signals with ease. It is rumored to be able to enter computer networks, leaving behind strange symbols.
stages.name: Devicore

stages.description: Overnode is a powerful creature capable of manipulating entire digital systems with its immense psychic abilities. Legends say it can create illusions so real, they become indistinguishable from reality.
stages.name: Overnode

stages.description: Kittanium is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Kittanium Egg

stages.description: Kittanium tumbles through play with boundless energy, its metallic fur flashing in the sunlight. Despite its small size, this lively cub easily bats around objects several times its own weight.
stages.name: Kittanium

stages.description: Leonite stands guard over its territory, trusting its metallic armor to withstand powerful blows. Beneath its imposing appearance, it retains a playful streak and frequently challenges companions to spirited mock battles.
stages.name: Leonite

stages.description: Steelking leads through unwavering loyalty, sheltering companions behind its resilient metallic hide. It stands firm through fierce storms, earning the trust of creatures that gather around it when danger approaches.
stages.name: Steelking

stages.description: Komantis is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Komantis Egg

stages.description: Komantis gathers stray electricity through its conductive scales while exploring nearby power sources. Its playful bursts create miniature static storms, though an unexpected noise quickly sends this gentle creature into hiding.
stages.name: Komantis

stages.description: Dracmanteon stalks the wilderness behind tough chitinous armor, stunning prey with swift movements and electric breath. It fiercely defends its territory and remains loyal to companions that have earned its trust.
stages.name: Dracmanteon

stages.description: Larvagon is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Larvagon Egg

stages.description: Larvagon, though still timid, now possess a newfound resilience thanks to their jade film. They are easily startled, but their gentle nature makes them popular among those looking for a companion, now with a touch of added mystique.
stages.name: Larvagon

stages.description: Chrysalis encase themselves in a jade-like shell as they prepare for their final evolution. During this phase, they absorb nutrients and dream of soaring through the skies.
stages.name: Chrysalis

stages.description: Sylvernalis emerges from its chrysalis with the power to revitalize barren lands. Its scales shimmer like freshly grown leaves, and its breath can coax flowers to bloom.
stages.name: Sylvernalis

stages.description: Lavacoon is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Lavacoon Egg

stages.description: Lavacoon are often found near geothermal vents, absorbing heat and minerals to fuel their rapid growth. They are timid creatures, retreating into their hardened larval shells when threatened, but their playful nature emerges when offered sweet nectars.
stages.name: Lavacoon

stages.description: Armalisk rests while hardened limbs and elaborate armor develop beneath its pupal shell. As its crest becomes more prominent, it grows increasingly territorial, preparing to defend itself when its transformation is complete.
stages.name: Armalisk

stages.description: Gladiatorb leads its colony with careful tactics and unwavering courage. Its crest has hardened into a helmet, protecting its head as bladed forearms and powerful mandibles deliver precise strikes in battle.
stages.name: Gladiatorb

stages.description: Stratalclaw is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Leafalon Egg

stages.description: Leafalon practices pouncing on fallen leaves in sunlit groves, revealing surprisingly sharp talons for its size. It carries shiny metal scraps back to its nest, carefully arranging them among its treasures.
stages.name: Leafalon

stages.description: Ferrohawk are territorial guardians of small groves and thickets. They use their sharpened talons to carve intricate patterns into tree trunks, marking their domain. These patterns serve as both warnings and declarations of their presence.
stages.name: Ferrohawk

stages.description: Stratalclaw are majestic aerial predators that command the skies. Their steel-plated feathers deflect even the strongest winds, allowing them to soar effortlessly through storms. Their loyalty to those they trust is unwavering.
stages.name: Stratalclaw

stages.description: Lithicub is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Lithicub Egg

stages.description: Lithicubs are playful, curious creatures that emerge from their stony eggs with an insatiable appetite for exploration. Though small and relatively defenseless, they possess an innate connection to the earth, foreshadowing the territorial might of their evolved form.
stages.name: Lithicub

stages.description: Netspark is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Netspark Egg

stages.description: Netsparks are bundles of nascent digital energy, drawn to acts of kindness and fairness. They gather strength from positive interactions, learning about justice and growing eager to help right wrongs.
stages.name: Netspark

stages.description: Solvolt lashes out with supercooled water and electrical arcs when threatened. Sensitive to nearby emotions, it mirrors the mood of its companions and becomes noticeably calmer in the presence of reassurance.
stages.name: Solvolt

stages.description: Spectsurge are volatile and aggressive, channeling water and electricity into devastating attacks. They are known to generate powerful electrical storms when enraged, turning the battlefield into a chaotic display of elemental force.
stages.name: Spectsurge

stages.description: Pebblatops is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Pebblatops Egg

stages.description: Pebblatops commands the rocky crags with its massive body and earthshaking power. When its territory is threatened, it summons tremors and landslides that send intruders scrambling away from the surrounding cliffs.
stages.name: Pebblatops

stages.description: Ceraforge patrols rocky terrain, carving territorial marks with its powerful horns. Its geode-like patterns shimmer faintly as it gathers strength, warning approaching rivals before a forceful display drives them away.
stages.name: Ceraforge

stages.description: Terraton stands like a living fortress, enduring immense force while defending its territory. Its horn glows with fiery energy drawn from the earth, and its movements reshape the rocky ground around it.
stages.name: Terraton

stages.description: Petralithe is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Petralithe Egg

stages.description: Petralithe are gentle creatures that bloom with vibrant colors when exposed to sunlight. They often nestle within ancient ruins, drawing energy from the earth's hidden power and sharing its bounty with nearby flora.
stages.name: Petralithe

stages.description: Litheglade are known for their deep connection to nature and the earth's ancient energy. They are capable of controlling the growth of plants and manipulating stone with their newfound ancient power, safeguarding forests and ruins alike.
stages.name: Litheglade

stages.description: Rumbleep is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Rumbleep Egg

stages.description: Rumbleep are curious creatures, often found near construction sites. They love the sound of machinery and will playfully mimic the motions of digging equipment, dreaming of one day becoming powerful excavators.
stages.name: Rumbleep

stages.description: Landrill are known for their incredible digging speed and accuracy. They use their reinforced horns and powerful forelimbs to create intricate tunnel systems, often helping construction crews with excavation projects. Their loyalty and skill make them valuable partners.
stages.name: Landrill

stages.description: Slimerick is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Slimerick Egg

stages.description: Slimericks are playful spirits often found near stagnant pools, delighting in harmless pranks. They are known to materialize small objects from the swamp, often leaving behind a trail of glistening slime.
stages.name: Slimerick

stages.description: Bogsterrants patrol the edges of swamps, warding off intruders with noxious fumes and unsettling howls. They are territorial and fiercely protective of their murky domains.
stages.name: Bogsterrant

stages.description: Murkhemoths are towering swamp guardians, their presence causing the very ground to rot and decay. They are said to possess an insatiable hunger for the lifeforce of intruders, leaving behind only withered husks.
stages.name: Murkhemoth

stages.description: Sludgling is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Sludgling Egg

stages.description: Sludglings are mischievous imps known for their playful antics and tendency to leave trails of glistening slime wherever they go. They enjoy hiding in dark corners, surprising unsuspecting passersby with harmless, albeit messy, pranks.
stages.name: Sludgling

stages.description: Toxispikes are cunning hunters that thrive in polluted environments. They use their enhanced senses to track prey, ambushing them with a barrage of toxic spikes and suffocating sludge.
stages.name: Toxispike

stages.description: Sparklutter is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Sparklutter Egg

stages.description: Sparklutters are playful, often found dancing amidst thunderstorms. Their tiny bodies generate static electricity, causing their fur to crackle with harmless sparks. They are incredibly curious, often approaching travelers with wide-eyed wonder.
stages.name: Sparklutter

stages.description: Ampterra hones its flight by chasing lightning through storm clouds. As its control over static electricity improves, it creates dazzling aerial displays and releases focused blasts to defend itself against approaching threats.
stages.name: Ampterra

stages.description: When threatened, Cryoshock can summon localized blizzards infused with electrical currents, freezing foes solid before unleashing a powerful bolt. Its confident demeanor reflects its mastery over two volatile elements, making it a truly formidable opponent.
stages.name: Cryoshock

stages.description: Necroflora is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Sproutomb Egg

stages.description: Sproutomb are mischievous little sprouts that absorb negative energy from polluted areas, using it to fuel their growth. They're often found near abandoned buildings, their presence a subtle sign of nature's resilience.
stages.name: Sproutomb

stages.description: Bloomwraith are larger and more territorial than their pre-evolution. They channel the negative energy they collect into a dark, poisonous miasma, which they use to defend themselves and help revitalize barren lands.
stages.name: Bloomwraith

stages.description: Necroflora are powerful protectors of nature, capable of cleansing entire ecosystems of pollution with their potent toxins. They represent nature's ability to reclaim and repurpose even the most desolate environments, transforming decay into new life.
stages.name: Necroflora

stages.description: Stinglet is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Stinglet Egg

stages.description: Stinglets are playful pranksters, often found hiding in dark corners to startle unsuspecting travelers. Despite their small size, their stings pack a surprisingly potent venom, though they usually only use it for defense... or a particularly good joke.
stages.name: Stinglet

stages.description: Reapions are much more serious than their younger counterparts. They stalk the shadows, silently hunting for prey. Their venom is now potent enough to incapacitate even large foes, and they use it with calculated precision.
stages.name: Reapion

stages.description: Therabolt is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Therabolt Egg

stages.description: Therabolt are the ultimate fusion of electric power and martial arts mastery. They can unleash devastating electrical punches and generate electromagnetic fields for both offense and defense, protecting their allies with unparalleled strength.
stages.name: Therabolt

stages.description: Umbralare is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Umbralare Egg

stages.description: Umbralare command respect and fear as guardians of forgotten power. Their fiery manes blaze brighter the closer they are to sources of ancient energy, and their shadow-infused claws can rend the veil between worlds.
stages.name: Umbralare

stages.description: Nocturnyx guards forgotten places beneath a hide of dark obsidian armor. Fiery patches glow between its plates, revealing the fierce heat within and warning intruders away before it begins to move.
stages.name: Nocturnyx

stages.description: Vexile is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Vexile Egg

stages.description: Vexile bounds between highland crags with spectral electricity crackling along its claws. When angered, it releases a violent surge that charges the surrounding air and forces nearby creatures to retreat.
stages.name: Vexile

stages.description: Clawgust hunts alone through dark storms, moving silently until its electrified claws strike. The lasting marks it leaves warn other creatures away from its territory long after the storm has passed.
stages.name: Clawgust

stages.description: Whimpergeist is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Whimpergeist Egg

stages.description: Whimpergeists are timid spirits, often found near graveyards, whimpering softly as they float. They are easily startled and tend to phase through objects when frightened, leaving behind a faint chill.
stages.name: Whimpergeist

stages.description: Purrltergeist haunts abandoned places, fiercely guarding its chosen home. Its chilling howls travel through empty rooms, followed by sudden gusts of cold wind that drive unwelcome visitors back outside.
stages.name: Purrltergeist

stages.description: Wybit is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Wybit Egg

stages.description: Wybit are born from the first sparks of online friendship and camaraderie. They earnestly patrol digital spaces, seeking opportunities to help others and foster positive connections, though they sometimes misinterpret harmless banter as genuine distress.
stages.name: Wybit

stages.description: Wyborg emerges from the digital ether when online communities are threatened. It uses crackling psychic energy to confront those causing harm, then disappears once calm has returned to the network.
stages.name: Wyborg

stages.description: Zenithruption is preserved as a sealed lifeform within this egg. Its shell patterns echo the species' core palette and markings.
stages.name: Zenithruption Egg

stages.description: Zenithruption are revered for their ability to control both water and fire in perfect harmony. Legends say their fiery breath can purify even the most polluted waters.
stages.name: Zenithruption
Dozolin Egg
stages.description: A sealed Dozolin waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Dozolin
stages.description: Dozolin follows pleasant dreams with its long snout. When it falls asleep mid-step, its psychic power carries it forward until it wakes, often leaving it somewhere it never meant to go.

stages.name: Narcolin
stages.description: Narcolin amplifies dream energy through the plates along its back. Even with its eyes closed, it senses approaching creatures through their thoughts and quietly nudges danger away without interrupting its sleep.

stages.name: Collipup Egg
stages.description: A sealed Collipup waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Collipup
stages.description: Collipup instinctively rounds up smaller creatures, sometimes mistaking drifting leaves for strays. The flower on its head opens when its little flock is safely gathered beneath the shade of a tree.

stages.name: Collibloom
stages.description: Collibloom guides wandering creatures home with gentle nudges from its flowering tail. Pollen caught in its shaggy coat spreads along familiar trails, turning its daily herding routes into ribbons of wildflowers.

stages.name: Collosom
stages.description: Collosom shelters its flock beneath a thick coat of leaves and blossoms. It remembers every creature in its care and searches tirelessly for stragglers, even after the rest have settled down.

stages.name: Rubbull Egg
stages.description: A sealed Rubbull waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Rubbull
stages.description: Rubbull rubs against mineral-rich cliffs to strengthen the stones growing across its back. Young ones challenge boulders to pushing contests and celebrate even the smallest movement with an excited little snort.

stages.name: Bullder
stages.description: Bullder braces its interlocking stone armor before charging, spreading the impact across its powerful body. It becomes perfectly still just before a rush; even its tail stops moving as it takes aim.

stages.name: Spirillo Egg
stages.description: A sealed Spirillo waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Spirillo
stages.description: Spirillo stores memories within the spirals on its shell, which brighten while it sleeps. Researchers report that touching an older marking sometimes brings back a dream they had long forgotten.

stages.name: Runursa
stages.description: Runursa senses an approaching attack through the crystal on its tail. It turns its armored body toward the danger before the attacker has finished deciding exactly where to strike.

stages.name: Anvilet Egg
stages.description: A sealed Anvilet waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Anvilet
stages.description: Anvilet searches riverbeds for iron-rich stones to strengthen its growing armor. The plates along its back click together whenever it finds an unfamiliar object, drawing curious companions to investigate alongside it.

stages.name: Anvilon
stages.description: Anvilon absorbs metal into overlapping armor plates that harden with each battle. Before a clash, it braces its heavy tail behind itself, becoming an obstacle even larger creatures struggle to move.

stages.name: Brewbit Egg
stages.description: A sealed Brewbit waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Brewbit
stages.description: Brewbit turns collected water into steam inside its tiny boiler. When excitement raises the pressure too quickly, its spout lets out a squeaky whistle that gives away its hiding place.

stages.name: Scaldron
stages.description: Scaldron regulates its boiler by tapping its feet in precise patterns. A sudden pause in the rhythm warns that pressure is building and a powerful burst of steam is about to follow.

stages.name: Chugernaut
stages.description: Chugernaut grips uneven ground with its many legs while its boiler drives it steadily forward. Travelers follow its distant whistle, knowing it returns to the same freshwater spring each evening.

stages.name: Wartox Egg
stages.description: A sealed Wartox waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Wartox
stages.description: Wartox shelters beneath a cap that absorbs gases from stagnant marshes. When startled, it releases a small puff and freezes, apparently convinced the foul-smelling cloud has hidden it completely from view.

stages.name: Smogroak
stages.description: Smogroak releases rolling fumes from the vents on its back. Its latest meal changes their scent, allowing other Smogroak to recognize familiar individuals long before they become visible through the marsh fog.

stages.name: Miasmorg
stages.description: Miasmorg filters swamp toxins through the chimneys on its back, storing them in a potent mixture. Nearby creatures carefully check the wind before approaching its territory, even when it appears asleep.

stages.name: Reveri Egg
stages.description: A sealed Reveri waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Reveri
stages.description: Reveri balances floating spheres while listening to thoughts too quiet for others to notice. A wobbling sphere usually means someone nearby is trying very hard to keep a secret from it.

stages.name: Dremir
stages.description: Dremir senses sleeping minds through its sweeping fins. When its three orbiting spheres align, nearby creatures briefly share the same dream, sometimes waking with memories of places they have never visited.

stages.name: Camolet Egg
stages.description: A sealed Camolet waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Camolet
stages.description: Camolet changes the shades of its leafy scales to blend into surrounding branches. Its curled tail grips tightly while it watches insects, though an excited rustle of its crest can betray it.

stages.name: Camoflair
stages.description: Camoflair shifts intricate patterns across its leaf-like armor, disappearing among sunlit foliage. When challenged, it flashes a brilliant contrasting display before darting away, leaving its rival staring at an empty branch.

stages.name: Nimsect Egg
stages.description: A sealed Nimsect waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Nimsect
stages.description: Nimsect trims tough stems with the small blades along its body. Its long feelers detect vibrations through leaves, helping it locate food while keeping its soft underside safely hidden from predators.

stages.name: Sablade
stages.description: Sablade folds its pale wing covers around itself until it resembles a hanging seedpod. When prey wanders close, its crimson blades unfold in one precise movement before the disguise settles again.

stages.name: Neuril Egg
stages.description: A sealed Neuril waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Neuril
stages.description: Neuril reveals ripples of light beneath its transparent crown whenever it learns something new. It may stare at unfamiliar objects for hours, occasionally lifting them without realizing its thoughts have moved them.

stages.name: Neuragon
stages.description: Neuragon predicts nearby movements as signals race beneath its transparent crown. Brief psychic impulses help it change direction sharply without losing speed, leaving pursuers struggling to follow its sudden turns.

stages.name: Jinxter Egg
stages.description: A sealed Jinxter waits within. Its markings hint at the creature growing inside.

stages.name: Jinxter
stages.description: Jinxter slips its wispy tail through narrow gaps to move objects just beyond reach. If its victim laughs instead of getting angry, it returns the object and eagerly follows them home.

stages.name: Prankenstein
stages.description: Prankenstein builds elaborate pranks from misplaced objects, using its ghostly tail to work unseen around corners. Despite its wicked grin, it quietly dismantles any trick that might cause someone genuine harm.
